findings.title: TRUNCATE bypass of fiscal triggers — documented but not enforced at DB layer
findings.evidence: Three migrations explicitly call out the TRUNCATE bypass: audit_logs (2026_04_22_000002 implied via standard trigger semantics), z_reports (2026_05_09_160000 line 30), cash_movements (2026_05_10_010000 line 47). Mitigation = REVOKE TRUNCATE on production DB user. Lives in deploy doc, not migration scope. Audit trail check: does docs/DEPLOY.md or equivalent grant-stripping doc exist?
findings.verdict: V1.1-BACKLOG (verify production DB grants doc + add CI sentinel that GRANT TRUNCATE on fiscal tables is NOT present)

findings.title: z_reports DELETE trigger lacks SQLite parity
findings.evidence: Migration 2026_05_09_160000 only installs MySQL/MariaDB trigger. SQLite test runner cannot verify z_reports DELETE rejection end-to-end. PHPUnit currently relies on app-layer check (ZReport model boot? not verified here). For NF525 compliance the test gap is acceptable because production runs MySQL — but a SQLite parity migration would close the loop (mirror migration 2026_05_16_130000 pattern for cash_movements).
findings.verdict: V1.1-BACKLOG (add z_reports SQLite trigger parity migration)

findings.title: order_payments lacks SQLite DELETE trigger parity
findings.evidence: Migration 2026_05_16_130000 only covers cash_movements + cash_drawer_sessions. order_payments has MySQL/MariaDB trigger from 2026_05_10_010000 but no SQLite test-runner equivalent. Same risk-acceptable rationale as DBA-PS3-02.
findings.verdict: V1.1-BACKLOG (extend SQLite parity migration to order_payments)

findings.title: composition_snapshot column lacks DB-level immutability trigger
findings.evidence: OrderItem composition_snapshot is the pricing JSON frozen at order creation per CLAUDE.md §8. App-layer enforcement is via PricingService SSOT + copy-forward pattern in RefundWithCounterEntryService. A future runaway UPDATE statement (admin tooling, ORM hot reload, manual SQL) would silently rewrite the snapshot. NF525 invariant is preserved by 6-year audit_logs retention (an UPDATE leaves a payload mismatch when chain is verified against snapshot), but a BEFORE UPDATE trigger that compares OLD.composition_snapshot vs NEW.composition_snapshot and SIGNAL '45000' on diff would be the canonical fix.
